text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"multi-paragraph response with intro, body paragraphs, and conclusion","quality":"organization","description":"The essay shows a clearer overall structure with distinct parts that guide the reader through the response."},{"evidence":"\"First, I have...\" / \"Second, I am...\" / \"Finally, I always...\"","quality":"paragraph development","description":"The essay develops its points in a more controlled sequence with recognizable supporting sections."},{"evidence":"\"I have a good grades\" \"I am interesting about business\" \"I like to work hard\"","quality":"idea elaboration","description":"The essay gives fuller supporting details for its claims rather than repeating the prompt text."},{"evidence":"\"I pay attention in class\" \"I do my homework every day\"","quality":"specific supporting detail","description":"The essay includes concrete examples that make the writer's reasons more explicit and credible."},{"evidence":"mostly original sentences rather than repeated prompt wording","quality":"independent expression","description":"The essay more often produces its own sentences and ideas instead of relying on copied or repeated prompt language."}]}
